683246a74073e586d112af9f Description: 6.5x48mm Creedmoor is a centrefire rifle cartridge introduced by Hornady in 2007. Bullet-for-bullet, the 6.5mm Creedmoor achieves a slower muzzle velocity than longer cartridges such as the 6.5-284 Norma or magnum cartridges such as the 6.5mm Remington Magnum. However, with an overall length of 2.825 inches (71.8 mm), it can be chambered in short-action rifles.
68325a63730b17c69ee176eb Description: 6.5x48mm Creedmoor HPBT (Hollow Point Boat Tail) is a rifle round intended for use against big game at long range, and as such has very little penetration in favour of high flesh-based damage. Red Tracer version.
6833baea86387d71b68abd6f Description: 6.5x48mm Creedmoor Hornady ELD-X (Extremely Low Drag - eXpanding) is a precision-engineered cartridge tailored for long-range hunting and tactical applications. 6833bae4baa31474639bea7d Description: 6.5x48mm Creedmoor Armor Piercing (AP) round is a high-performance, intermediate-caliber cartridge engineered for precision, penetration, and adaptability in modern combat scenarios. 6833ba38a1c9ff155c04e56f Description: Any hunt. Any range. 6834e6f28f5570aec23ca0c2 Description: 6.5x48mm Creedmoor 120gr C-HP are specially designed to suit both the hunter and target shooter. These copper bullets are designed and manufactured in the UK. The Expansion cavity in these projectiles were designed to expand on immediate impact with the target.
